title: I Need Your Input! - This Video is For The Adults To Comment
fulltitle: I Need Your Input! - This Video is For The Adults To Comment
description:
Because you can't comment on kids videos, I have created this video to introduce myself and ask that you share feedback with me. Please comment and thank you so much for watching!

I need beta testers for my reading tracker app. Please comment and visit: https://www.bookleague.app

Thank you for visiting my channel again. Here at Book League Storytime Adventures we believe that reading is one of the most important things you can do with your children. We strive to create a safe and educational space for both parents and teachers alike, while creating the most entertaining read alouds out there. 

Please subscribe! 
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC1R8HXI-ZT1KU5W7_pQiLKw?sub_confirmation=1

Benefits of Reading:
-Relieves Stress and Depression
-Improves memory and brain function 
-Slows down cognitive decline
-Increases vocabulary and spelling ability 
-Increases empathy 
-Improves writing skills
-Increases attention span
-Increases life span
-And many more!
